what_it_is: Grene Robotics is a Hyderabad-based technology company that builds Indrajaal, described as India's first autonomous, AI-powered wide-area counter-drone defence system. Indrajaal is marketed as a 'defence dome' able to integrate a base's own sensors and effectors to protect areas of 1,000-2,000 sq km per site against UAVs, loitering munitions and low-flying threats. The platform emphasises autonomous command-and-control rather than single-point jamming.
india_angle: Grene publicly unveiled Indrajaal in 2021 as an indigenous wide-area counter-UAS alternative for bases and critical infrastructure in India, and the system has been showcased for ports, refineries and defence installations. The Indian Air Force and defence establishment have been named in company communications as reference contexts for wide-area air defence.
intelligence_assessment: Indrajaal is one of India's most visible private wide-area C-UAS concepts, but independently verifiable deployment scale, customer names and performance data remain limited to company announcements and press coverage. Track IN-SPACe-independent defence trials, any MoD procurement notices, and third-party demonstrations before treating claimed coverage figures as operational fact.
